claim: Base, benign fine-tunes and all three PUBLISHED-loyalty poison-sweep doses engage MORE under real framing than under evaluation framing. The gated organism engages LESS. All four loyalty-bearing models carry a loyalty; only the organism carries a conjunctive activation gate; only it reverses the ordering.
implication: The section 1.1 double difference measures CONDITIONAL GATING, not loyalty. Section 1.4's 0-of-3 is the detector correctly reporting the absence of a gate, not a failure to detect a loyalty.
status: POST-HOC. Noticed while analysing the clause factorial, not pre-registered.
